title: Muay Thai
description:
1. Take a balanced Muay Thai stance with feet staggered, hips relatively square, chin tucked, and forearms high.
2. Move through range and combine punches, teeps, shin kicks, knees, elbows, checks, and controlled clinch entries.
3. Recoil each strike and return the feet, elbows, and hands to stance before starting the next action.
